status: Thirteen source definitions updated; final build and 15,169 fixed slots pass. Seven complete entry-reachable CFG comparisons match.

source_reviews.name: card_tibor_and_lumia
source_reviews.reason: Restore the native trigger-time blue query, red query, test initialization order. Keep both saved colors across initialization. The later resolution-time color queries, target callbacks and red damage continuation are unchanged. No newly demonstrated gameplay defect is asserted for this setup-order restoration.

source_reviews.name: card_harness_the_storm
source_reviews.reason: Restore the native trigger-time get_card_name snapshot before default_test_definition and use the saved ID afterward. Preserve all in-play, humiliation, trigger/affected/controller/hand guards and the later separate resolution-time name lookup. No new arbitrary callee equivalence assumption or gameplay-bug claim.

source_reviews.name: card_skyclave_apparition
source_reviews.reason: Split the merged duh-mode/owner temporary and select the native high halfword through inst_info_t.data2. The header defines both id and data2 as uint16_t; the previous packing expression equals data2 for every field value. Preserve the two distinct inst_info calls after token initialization and the ETB owner-before-CMC snapshot sequence.

source_reviews.name: graft_trigger
source_reviews.reason: Reconstruct the positive ETB/affected/controller/counter guard and give the trigger mode its own local. Keep AI is_what before conditional toughness query and read trigger_cause_controller only after those queries when applicable. Test setup remains after mode selection; the separate EVENT_ETB counter transfer uses live trigger coordinates afterward.

source_reviews.name: triskelion_like_creature
source_reviews.reason: Consolidate the native duplicated target setup after the same four-event filter. EVENT_RESOLVE_ACTIVATION and EVENT_CAN_ACTIVATE are adjacent (0x72/0x73); explicit event membership preserves the original unsigned interval. Keep ETB counters before filtering, validation before damage and the final activation-helper call even after damage.

source_reviews.name: is_aura_or_equipment
source_reviews.reason: Reconstruct the ordered short-circuit predicate and ordinary boolean return. Keep equipment lookup first, enchantment-type lookup only on failure, and a fresh cards_data[iid].id read after that lookup before checking aura subtype. The second subtype result is still normalized to 0/1.

source_reviews.name: altar_extended
source_reviews.reason: Separate the chosen sacrifice-card index from boolean availability queries. Keep all three queries in native order even when their act_mode bits are clear. Preserve the getter before event dispatch, per-stat query/store interleaving, kill before conditional tap and native availability-bit arithmetic.

source_reviews.name: check_for_flanking_removal
source_reviews.reason: Split state/opponent and candidate-ID/result temporaries into the state guard, saved opponent and candidate index. Keep in_play then ID then conditional humiliation, including the native -1 short-circuit, and reread the active count after each query iteration. No helper query is hoisted across a callback.

source_reviews.name: card_natural_reclamation
source_reviews.reason: Reconstruct the native affected-CAST branch with its shared zero result, retaining the exact spell_fizzled==1 cancellation test. Cascade remains after generic_spell, only when that test permits it. Other events and unaffected CAST still return card_disenchant directly.

source_reviews.name: select_target_maybe_force
source_reviews.reason: Remove redundant result=0 comma assignments from the retry eligibility predicate: its enclosing branch already proves result==0 and no intervening call can change that local. Preserve live ai_is_speculating lookup, controller-mask checks, retry packet with only preferred_controller XOR1, and success-only AI penalty.

source_reviews.name: card_aysen_crusader
source_reviews.reason: Replace the remaining decompiler placeholder scan index with candidate. Keep every native Soldier/Warrior short-circuit query and the live active-card loop bound; the base2 characteristic remains added only after the scan. No control-flow or gameplay change.

source_reviews.name: card_necroskitter
source_reviews.reason: Restore the native fresh get_card_instance after nonzero GFP resolution, instead of caching it before duh_mode/resolve_gfp_ability. Keep the kill-code getter before those callbacks and the later getter even for a negative nonzero amount, with the positive bounded loop still deciding reanimation. Use the native kill_code==0 predicate; the current unsigned field also made <=0 equivalent.

source_reviews.name: card_scythe_of_the_wretched
source_reviews.reason: Restore native death-scan query order: in_play, creature test, token test, stored-count guard, is_this_dying, death-trigger-removal check, then a fresh stored-count loop condition. This retains live affected coordinates between callbacks and avoids invoking removal checking for candidates rejected earlier by the native code. Also clamp the damage-record index locally and store the final count only after both target writes, as native code does. No rules fixes, capacity changes or invented safety checks.
